title: Brunodelphinine A alleviates non-alcoholic fatty liver disease by inhibiting oxidative stress and regulating lipid metabolism via NOX4/SIRT1/PPARs axis.
authors: Wang, Meiqi; Yang, Beixuan; Li, Xin; Ma, Huanhuan; Ou, Xia; Dawa, Zeren; Liu, Fangle; Zhu, Chenchen; Lin, Chaozhan
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然产物BruA通过NOX4/SIRT1/PPARs轴改善非酒精性脂肪肝，虽含分子对接但核心为代谢疾病机制，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Nonalcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD), which is characterized by the accumulation of fat in the liver, has emerged as a leading cause of chronic liver diseases and malignancies. However, there remains a scarcity of approved therapeutic interventions. Brunodelphinine A (BruA) is a diterpenoid alkaloid isolated from Delphinium brunonianum Royle. in our previous study. It was evaluated with strong activity of lipid-lowering. Nevertheless, its precise effects and mechanisms in the treatment of NAFLD remain unexplored. PURPOSE: The present study aims to elucidate the effects of BruA against NAFLD and to investigate its potential pharmacological mechanism. METHODS: The lipid-lowering and anti-NAFLD effects of BruA were evaluated in the free fatty acid (FFA)-induced cell model and high-fat diet (HFD)-induced mice. Network pharology analysis combined with Non-targeted metabolomics study was used to explore the key mechanism of BruA. Furthermore, molecular docking and cellular thermal shift assay (CETSA) were used to simulate and verify the targeting activation of BruA on the NADPH oxidase 4 (NOX4). The core role of NOX4 in BruA in regulating nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide (NAD(+))/Sirtuin 1 (SIRT1) and peroxisome proliferators-activated receptors (PPARs) signaling pathway to improve oxidative stress and lipid metabolic disorders was further focused, and such mechanism was evaluated in WT and NOX4 knockout mice or HepG2 cells. RESULTS: BruA dose-dependently reduced FFA-induced lipid accumulation and cell damage in vitro, and mitigated HFD-induced NAFLD in mice. At the metabolite level, BruA improved metabolic disorder in NAFLD mice focusing on the metabolism of arachidonic acid and linolenic acid, which has been considered as signs of oxidative stress, that positively correlated with NAFLD. BruA targeting inhibited NOX4 to mitigate reactive oxygen species (ROS)-mediated oxidative stress and prevent abnormal redox levels, thereby regulating NAD(+)/SIRT1 in protecting the liver from oxidative damage, and further affected downstream PPARs-related lipid metabolism regulation processes, thus alleviating hepatic lipid accumulation. Furthermore, NOX4 deficiency suppressed the protective effect of BruA in vitro and in vivo. CONCLUSION: BruA improved oxidative stress and lipid metabolic disorders of NAFLD by regulating the NOX4-SIRT1-PPARs signaling axis in vivo and in vitro, and this regulation is targeting dependent on NOX4. For its mechanisms of antioxidant stress and lipid-lowering, there is great therapeutic potential for BruA in the treatment of period with elevated lipids and inflammation production in NAFLD.
abstract_zh: 背景：非酒精性脂肪性肝病（NAFLD）以肝脏脂肪积累为特征，已成为慢性肝病和恶性肿瘤的主要原因。然而，获批的治疗干预措施仍然稀缺。布鲁诺德芬碱A（BruA）是我们前期研究中从毛茛科翠雀属植物Delphinium brunonianum Royle.中分离得到的一种二萜生物碱，其具有强效降脂活性。然而，其在NAFLD治疗中的确切作用和机制尚未被探索。目的：本研究旨在阐明BruA对抗NAFLD的作用，并探讨其潜在药理机制。方法：在游离脂肪酸（FFA）诱导的细胞模型和高脂饮食（HFD）诱导的小鼠中评估了BruA的降脂和抗NAFLD作用。采用网络药理学分析结合非靶向代谢组学研究探索BruA的关键机制。此外，使用分子对接和细胞热位移分析（CETSA）模拟并验证BruA对NADPH氧化酶4（NOX4）的靶向激活。进一步聚焦于NOX4在BruA调节烟酰胺腺嘌呤二核苷酸（NAD(+)）/Sirtuin 1（SIRT1）和过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体（PPARs）信号通路以改善氧化应激和脂质代谢紊乱中的核心作用，并在野生型和NOX4敲除小鼠或HepG2细胞中评估了该机制。结果：BruA剂量依赖性地减少FFA诱导的体外脂质积累和细胞损伤，并缓解HFD诱导的小鼠NAFLD。在代谢物水平上，BruA改善了NAFLD小鼠的代谢紊乱，主要涉及花生四烯酸和亚麻酸的代谢，这些被认为是氧化应激的标志，且与NAFLD正相关。BruA靶向抑制NOX4以减轻活性氧（ROS）介导的氧化应激并防止异常氧化还原水平，从而调节NAD(+)/SIRT1以保护肝脏免受氧化损伤，并进一步影响下游PPARs相关的脂质代谢调节过程，从而缓解肝脏脂质积累。此外，NOX4缺陷在体外和体内抑制了BruA的保护作用。结论：BruA通过调节NOX4-SIRT1-PPARs信号轴在体内和体外改善NAFLD的氧化应激和脂质代谢紊乱，且该调节靶向依赖于NOX4。鉴于其抗氧化应激和降脂机制，BruA在NAFLD中脂质升高和炎症产生期间的治疗中具有巨大潜力。
